plugins.name: Music Visualizer
plugins.description: Spectrum, scope, waveform, radial, particles and pitch visuals for audio-only files. Pick a mode with the dropdown or V.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Skip Intro & Credits
plugins.description: One Skip button for intros, credits and the segments extensions such as SponsorBlock find: chapter names (Intro, Opening, OP, Credits, Ending, ED; markers like "End of intro" are not skipped), your per-show ranges, or the extension. A segment found twice gets one button. Skip, ask or off per category or source, Undo after automatic skips, mute segments, "Always skip the intro of this show", Alt+K / Alt+Shift+K.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Offer to always skip for a show

changelog.notes: One Skip button for everything: extensions submit segments (vivi-skip-ranges; SponsorBlock 1.3 shows "Skip sponsor" here instead of its own prompt), merged with chapter names and per-show ranges so one segment gets one button. Skip / ask / off per category or source, Undo for a few seconds after automatic skips, "Unmute" for mute segments, an offer to always skip a show's intro or credits, Alt+K / Alt+Shift+K and palette commands. Fixes: "End of intro" style chapter markers and post-credits scenes were taken as ranges; skipping credits in the last file did nothing; show names now ignore [tags] and " - 05" episode numbers.
First version: Skip button from chapter names and per-show ranges, Mark from Settings, optional automatic skip.

plugins.name: Lyrics
plugins.description: Synced lyrics as a karaoke overlay or a full-screen karaoke view with word-by-word highlight (enhanced LRC). Sources: a .lrc file next to the song, embedded tags (USLT/SYLT/LYRICS), cache, LRCLIB (plain lyrics as fallback) and a manual search. Per-track timing offset; save as .lrc or embed. Radio streams: lyrics for the current stream title.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Full-screen karaoke view (L / side panel) with word-level highlight for enhanced LRC, smooth scrolling and dimmed past/next lines; per-track timing offset ([ / ] ±0.1 s, Shift ±0.5 s); Find Lyrics dialog (Ctrl+L: edit artist/title, results with duration and synced/plain); embedded lyrics (USLT/SYLT/LYRICS/©lyr) and LRCLIB plain lyrics as sources; save as .lrc or embed in tags.

plugins.name: Subtitle Search
plugins.description: Find subtitles on OpenSubtitles (by file hash, name or IMDb id) in the Add Subtitles dialog, and keep a subtitle offset per file (z / x).
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Hash search first (Exact match badge), then by name or IMDb id; multi-language chips (remembered); results with downloads, rating, FPS, hearing-impaired, trusted and machine-translation badges; details and text preview; one-click Load; pick remembered per file; optional save next to the video; per-file subtitle offset (z / x ±0.1 s, Shift ±1 s, side panel) with Auto-sync via the Subtitle Auto-Sync plugin.

plugins.name: Auto-tagger
plugins.description: Identifies songs by their audio (AcoustID fingerprint, system fpcalc first) or tags, merges MusicBrainz, Deezer, iTunes, Last.fm and Discogs ranked by confidence, and writes tags, hi-res covers and optional LRCLIB lyrics after a preview: per-field source badges, switch to another source's value, cover candidates, synced/plain lyrics, opt-in safe rename from a pattern. Batch folders, backups and Undo. Keys optional.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: Merged sources ranked by match confidence (agreeing sources raise it, duplicates collapse); per-field alternatives from other sources (⇄); lyrics rows show LRCLIB synced vs plain; file card notes fingerprinter and sources; fingerprint matches suggest a file name from a pattern (opt-in, never overwrites, sanitized); batch progress with matched/skipped counts; keys also from VIVI_ACOUSTID_KEY / VIVI_LASTFM_KEY / VIVI_DISCOGS_TOKEN.

plugins.name: Free Music
plugins.description: Search and browse Creative Commons and public-domain music from Jamendo, the Internet Archive and the Free Music Archive in one list with source badges: genres, moods, licence filters (commercial use, CC BY, BY-SA, CC0), sort, infinite scroll, album and artist pages, play similar, and downloads with tags, cover and licence attribution. Jamendo needs a free client ID.
plugins.author: Vivi

plugins.name: Network Streams
plugins.description: Internet radio (radio-browser.info, SomaFM), iptv-org TV by country and category, your own M3U/IPTV playlists that refresh themselves, favorites, group and category chips, channel logos, an XMLTV program guide (now / next) and stream info. No key needed; nothing bundled, everything fetched and cached on demand.
plugins.author: Vivi

changelog.notes: XMLTV program guide (now / next from the playlist url-tvg or a guide URL setting; only 12 hours kept), favorites pinned on top, group-title chips and iptv-org category chips, My playlists (custom M3U URLs that refresh themselves, last updated, broken links keep the last good copy), Search all (TV + radio), Add to queue and Mini player actions, broken logos remembered and a 64 MB logo cache cap.

plugins.name: Discord Rich Presence
plugins.description: Shows what you play in your Discord status: title, artist, progress, YouTube thumbnails, optional link button; privacy options to hide names or videos. Needs a Discord application ID; Discord must be running on this computer. Ships a small native helper (vivi-discord) that talks to Discord's local IPC.

plugins.name: Playback Statistics
plugins.description: Counts time watched and listened per day, with top artists and shows, today / 7 / 30 / 365-day totals and your day streak. Kept locally in a small TSV file; Alt+S shows a summary, pause recording, export as CSV or clear any time.

changelog.notes: Statistics in Vivi's own plugin dialog (Alt+S, the new Home widget, the side-drawer tab and the palette): Today / 7 / 30 / 365-day chips, grouped by artist or show, title or day with bars, a filter field, totals and a day streak; older Vivi keeps an OSD panel, now below the title bar (it covered the first line), and the toast is one line instead of the whole chart. Record statistics switch to pause counting. Pauses and buffering are timed exactly (up to 5 s were lost or added per pause). Summary covers applies live. Clear asks first. README: requires Vivi 0.9.0 (not 0.8.0); new screenshots.

plugins.name: Remote Control
plugins.description: Control Vivi from your phone: a dark, touch-friendly web page with cover art, seek, play/pause/next, volume and mute, speed, audio and subtitle tracks, chapters, the queue, library search, fullscreen, open URL, play next and a sleep timer, updated live. Pair by scanning a QR code; PIN protected and local-network only by default. Installs to the home screen. Ships a small native helper (vivi-remote) that serves the page.

changelog.notes: New: sleep timer on the phone page (15–90 minutes or the end of the current file; Vivi pauses with a toast, the page counts down), Play next for library results and Open URL, and repeat (off / queue / this file) and shuffle buttons on Vivi versions whose own buttons follow them (after 0.12.0; hidden on older ones). Show QR code no longer also shows the address and PIN as a toast on Vivi 0.11.0+ (it has the QR dialog). Fixes: a phone that was connected when the PIN changed (New PIN) kept polling with the old PIN, cleared the PIN being typed every second and locked itself out for a minute; the Library tab never found Vivi's control socket without XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (macOS), as it looked in ~/.cache instead of ~/.cache/vivi; the helper retries the port for a few seconds after a restart instead of failing with "address in use"; the docs said the QR dialog and fullscreen need Vivi 0.10.1, it is 0.11.0; the Library hint names the actual setting (Allow AI agents and scripts). Security: the PIN reaches the helper on stdin instead of its command line (readable by every local user) on Linux and macOS; the PIN setting is masked; embedded covers are extracted into a fresh owner-only folder instead of a predictable /tmp file; the failed-PIN table is pruned.

Redesigned phone page in Vivi's style (dark, orange accent, Inter, Lucide icons, big touch targets; phone portrait/landscape and tablet layouts). New: live updates, mute, speed, audio/subtitle track picker, chapters, queue remove, library search (with Settings → General → Remote control → Allow AI agents and scripts), fullscreen, open URL, add to home screen (web app manifest and icon). Pair by QR code (Show QR code; the QR dialog and fullscreen need Vivi 0.11.0+, older versions show a toast), New PIN action, Local network only setting; the PIN is no longer put in URLs and DNS-rebinding requests are refused. Fixes: quotes around the address in the toast, a stale cover after switching files, cover art for files that were still loading, queue names without file extensions, sizes in the catalog include the helper.
First release as a downloadable plugin with a native helper (moved out of the core).

plugins.name: Scrobbler (Last.fm & ListenBrainz)
plugins.description: Sends what you listen to to Last.fm and/or ListenBrainz: now playing when a track starts and a scrobble after half the track or 4 minutes. Offline scrobbles are queued and sent later; love the playing track with Alt+L; podcasts, audiobooks and chosen folders are skipped. Needs your ListenBrainz user token, or your Last.fm API key + shared secret (free) and one browser authorisation.

settings.title: Last.fm session key (optional, instead of Connect)

changelog.notes: Love the playing track (Alt+L) on Last.fm and ListenBrainz; skip podcasts, audiobooks (.m4b) and chosen folders; repeat one counts every play; Connect Last.fm finishes by itself once you allow access, plus Disconnect; Status checks the ListenBrainz token and says why a file is not scrobbled; streams described by music packages (YouTube Music) are scrobbled; album artist, track number and MusicBrainz release / artist ids are sent. Privacy: the Last.fm session key moves out of Vivi's config into a private 0600 file, tokens no longer appear on curl's command line or in mpv's log, queue files are 0600, and the ListenBrainz token is only sent over https. Fixes: a wrong Last.fm secret or API key no longer deletes the offline queue, one rejected listen no longer drops a whole batch, messages are Vivi toasts instead of mpv's hidden OSD, the Last.fm session survives restarts on Vivi 0.9.0, MD5 works on Lua 5.1 builds without the bit library, and the needless filesystem permission is gone. On Vivi 0.13+: track data comes from Vivi's shared now-playing track (tags, library and music-package metadata merged; no own copy of vivi-media-meta), secret settings come from a private file instead of mpv's script-opts (which mpv logs), and live radio is not scrobbled.
Last.fm scrobbling and now playing (your API key + browser authorisation), next to ListenBrainz; separate offline queue per service.

plugins.name: YouTube Music
plugins.description: Your own YouTube Music account in Vivi: search songs, albums, artists and playlists, your liked songs, playlists, saved albums and history, up next and mixes, likes and adding to playlists, with Premium audio when your account has it. Signs in with your browser's cookies (kept in a private file, wiped on Sign out). Optional downloads with tags and cover, also of whole playlists, albums and liked songs as Vivi playlists you can sync, off by default. Unofficial: uses YouTube Music's web API, not a Google-approved app; it may break when Google changes it, and Google may restrict accounts that use it. Needs yt-dlp (the YouTube & yt-dlp plugin provides one), curl and a Vivi with the plugin music dialog: 0.13, or a 0.12.0 build from master of 18 Oct 2026 or later.
plugins.author: Vivi

settings.title: Or a cookies.txt / copied request headers file of a music.youtube.com request
Or paste a Cookie header, request headers or "Copy as cURL" from the clipboard

settings.title: Delete the stored cookies (your browser stays signed in)

settings.title: Up next after a song played from search
Audio only (turn off to watch music videos)
Allow downloads (off by default; may violate YouTube's Terms of Service, personal use only, at your own risk; needs yt-dlp)
Stop the running download and empty the queue
settings.label: Cancel downloads

changelog.notes: First release: sign in with your browser's cookies (browser, cookies.txt / headers file or clipboard), search, liked songs, playlists, albums and history, album / playlist / artist pages, up next and mixes, likes and adding to playlists, now-playing card, opt-in downloads with tags and cover, and Download playlist / Sync for playlists, albums and liked songs (a Vivi playlist in YouTube Music's order). Needs a Vivi with the plugin music dialog (0.13, or a 0.12.0 master build of 18 Oct 2026 or later); on the 0.12.0 release Open explains that instead of doing nothing.
